messages:
Mia R.: Quick sanity sweep before onboarding zeta-70b-ext tomorrow — need to confirm weights path, tokenizer padding, and kv-cache format so we don't hit OOMs in prod. Can people run quick checks?
Sanjay P.: Weights are at s3://redwood-weights/zeta-70b-ext/v1/ — double-checking that the manifest points to .bin shards. I ran ls, looks good.
Olivia G.: Noted. Tokenizer had a missing pad_token on last import; you should run `python -c 'from transformers import AutoTokenizer; print(AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained("./tokenizer").pad_token)'` to confirm.
Mia R.: thanks. can someone validate max_seq_len in serving config? last time it was left at 131072 and that wrecked the kv cache assumptions.
David K.: don't set max_seq_len > 65536 for this model on current quantized runtime. KV struct v2 expects per-shard layout; older v1 loads will try to allocate full-staging memory and OOM.
Sanjay P.: I pushed a small config diff, set `max_seq_len: 65536` and `kv_format: v2`. PR is https://github.com/redwood-inference/models/pull/482 — @Olivia G. PTAL.
Olivia G.: lgtm, but run tokenizer smoke first. I saw some tokenizers map unk to 0 which confuses padding logic.
Mia R.: Can infra run a quick mem-sim job (1 node, 1 batch, seq=64k) to smoke test? If it survives then try seq=65k to see failure mode.
infra-bot: Create job: mem-sim/zeta-70b-ext | nodes=1 gpus=2 batch=1 seq_len=65536 — queued (job id mem-2912)
QA-bot: mem-sim job mem-2912 completed: peak GPU mem 44.7GB, no OOM. logs: https://ci.redwood/mem-2912/logs
David K.: good. try seq_len=70000 on next run to confirm graceful failure and fallback path.
Sanjay P.: starting mem-sim 2 with seq=70000 (mem-2913)
infra-bot: mem-2913 failed: CUDA OOM at step 3, trace shows kv-allocation attempt for 70000 tokens.
Mia R.: perfect repro. I'll add a hard validation in the onboarding script to reject `max_seq_len` > 65536 and auto-suggest kv_format:v2 if weights are sharded. Also adding tokenizer pad check.
Olivia G.: thanks — can you add the small script snippet so infra can auto-run during package upload?
Mia R.: sure, snippet I'll add:
```bash
# quick tokenizer/pad check
python - <<'PY'
from transformers import AutoTokenizer
t=AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained('./tokenizer')
print('pad_token', t.pad_token)
PY
```
Mia R.: wrapping up — folks, if you see the PR please approve. I'll cut the onboarding checklist update after approvals. :thumbsup:
Sanjay P.: approved.
Olivia G.: approved.
David K.: approved.
Mia R.: thanks all.
